
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /usage  (/cost)                            │
  │  Session Usage & Cost                       │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Show this session's token usage and estimated cost.

  Usage:
    /usage
    /usage browser

  Details:
    Displays input/output token totals for the current session and
    OpenRouter reported session cost, or estimates for other providers.
    Use /usage browser to open OpenRouter account spend in your browser.

  Examples:
    $ /usage
    $ /cost

  Related: /stats  /ratelimit
